name: Grid MasterB
summary: Grid MasterB is a grid trading Expert Advisor that places buy and sell pending orders at fixed price intervals around the current market price, aiming to profit from market oscillations within a range. It systematically manages a grid of orders by spacing them at configured distances and optionally uses lot multiplication after losing trades. The EA continuously opens new grid levels as price moves, capturing profits from each grid line hit.
summary_zh: Grid MasterB是一个网格交易EA，在当前市场价格上下以固定间距放置买卖挂单，旨在从市场区间震荡中获利。它系统地管理订单网格，按配置距离排列，并可选择在亏损交易后加倍手数。随着价格移动，EA持续开启新的网格层级，从每次触及网格线时捕获利润。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典网格交易策略，在当前价格上下方按固定间距布置买卖挂单，利用市场在区间内反复波动来获利。入场条件是当价格触及网格线时自动触发挂单成交，无需额外信号确认。出场条件通常是在每笔订单设置固定止盈目标，当价格回调到目标位时平仓获利。仓位管理方面，EA允许配置初始手数和网格间距，部分变体支持马丁格尔式的手数递增以摊平成本。资金管理依赖于网格间距和止盈比例的合理设置，但缺乏全局止损机制，在单边行情中可能面临严重浮亏。整体策略假设市场会在一定范围内震荡，一旦出现趋势性行情，网格账户风险将急剧上升。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a classic grid trading strategy that places buy and sell pending orders at fixed intervals above and below the current price, profiting from market oscillations within a trading range. Entry conditions are triggered automatically when price reaches a grid level, executing the corresponding pending order without requiring additional signal confirmation. Exit conditions typically involve fixed take-profit targets for each individual order, closing positions when price reverts to the target level. Position sizing allows configuration of the initial lot size and grid spacing, with some variants supporting Martingale-style lot multiplication after losses to average down the entry price. Money management relies on the proper calibration of grid distance and take-profit ratio, but lacks a global stop-loss mechanism, exposing the account to severe drawdowns during strong trending markets. The overall strategy assumes mean-reverting market behavior, and account risk escalates dramatically when sustained trends develop against the grid direction.
pros: 在震荡行情中能稳定获利，每次价格触及网格线都能捕获利润
策略逻辑清晰，参数直观，便于理解和调优
无需复杂技术指标，减少了指标滞后和信号误判的问题
pros_en: Generates consistent profits in ranging markets, capturing profit each time price hits a grid level
Strategy logic is clear and parameters are intuitive, making it easy to understand and optimize
Does not rely on complex technical indicators, reducing lag and false signal issues
cons: 单边趋势行情中浮亏会急剧扩大，可能导致爆仓
缺乏全局止损机制，风险控制完全依赖参数设置的合理性
资金占用大，多层网格挂单需要大量保证金支撑
cons_en: Drawdowns escalate rapidly during trending markets, potentially leading to margin call and account blow-up
Lacks a global stop-loss mechanism, risk control relies entirely on the reasonableness of parameter settings
High margin requirement as multi-level grid pending orders demand significant account capital to sustain
improvements: 增加全局止损或最大浮亏限制，防止极端行情下账户爆仓
加入趋势过滤机制，在明确趋势行情时暂停或减少网格开仓
improvements_en: Add a global stop-loss or maximum drawdown limit to prevent account blow-up during extreme market conditions
Incorporate a trend filter to pause or reduce grid order placement when a clear trend is detected

risk_points: 网格策略在单边趋势中浮亏无限扩大，无全局止损保护
马丁格尔式手数递增会加速保证金消耗，增加爆仓概率
risk_points_en: Grid strategy exposes unlimited drawdown during trending markets with no global stop-loss protection
Martingale-style lot multiplication accelerates margin consumption and increases margin call probability
